decisions.reason: The upgraded trommel screen has shown positive customer reception and likely meets aspirations, so it is kept.
The flail shredder line has dedicated web support and complements the shredder range, and slack allows keeping it while demand develops.
The general high-speed grinder line has several models but limited visibility, yet no clear shortfall triggers search, so it is kept.
The stationary electric fine shredder is a niche product with limited web presence, but no evidence of below-aspiration results supports keeping it.
The green-waste grinder overlaps with the flail shredder and general grinder lines, and its limited website presence suggests results below aspirations, so the firm drops it to free resources.
The single-shaft pre-shredder line has a dedicated page and complements existing pre-shredders, so it likely meets aspirations and is kept.
